media.altText: Halftone portrait of the film director Reinhold Schünzel, smiling, in a light suit.
media.description: Portrait detail cropped from the page carrying the entry “REINHOLD SCHÜNZEL” in the digitised book. The full page and its biographical text remain available in the linked scan.
media.publicCaption: Reinhold Schünzel, who directed Balalaika in 1939. The portrait accompanies his entry in the publicity reference book Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer issued in 1937, three years after he left Germany for Hollywood.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unnamed; Who's Who at Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer (Culver City: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, 1937), entry "REINHOLD SCHÜNZEL"; digitised by the Media History Digital Library from the copy in the collection of Karl Thiede.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States. Who's Who at Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer was issued in 1937 by the studio's publicity department as a reference book for the press. The digitised copy carries no copyright notice: none appears on the title page, on the leaves facing it, or in the end matter, and a United States work published in 1937 without notice entered the public domain on publication. Had a notice been present, the copyright would in any case have required renewal in 1964 or 1965. No photographer is credited for the individual portraits.
